first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, while two inherited findings indicate that reducing signup and onboarding friction improves early adoption. Verify the more directly relevant onboarding record before committing, and use a guarded test because the primary objective is long-term qualified revenue rather than completion alone; monitor downstream qualification, conversion, retention, and revenue quality.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening the onboarding flow. The verified source directly addresses the current 4% completion decline and shows completion +13%, time-to-value improved by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention +3%; the related signup-simplification memory also supports reduced friction as a driver of activation. Measure qualified conversion and longer-term revenue alongside completion and activation because the verified record does not directly establish long-term revenue impact.
